decisions.reason: A burner component for the firm's core radiant heaters costs little to keep and supports the established gas infrared line, so the option stays open, although its low visibility makes some consolidation possible.
The electric infrared panel heater is a flagship aligned with electrification and decarbonization, has its own page, and its uncertain but promising prospects justify keeping the option open.
The halogen infrared heater is a low-cost addition to the electric portfolio that extends coverage to outdoor and spot heating, so keeping it while demand evidence accumulates is cheap.
The industrial electric hall heater fits the core customer base of halls and logistics sites in a growing electrification market, so its option value remains high.
The hydrogen-ready dark radiator is a flagship already in real operation and central to the firm's lower-carbon direction, so the firm will hold and likely expand this option.
